figurative_meaning_en: companion word; extreme intimacy; full of sincerity
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা সবসময় গলাগলি করে কথা বলে।
অফিসে বেশি গলাগলি করা উচিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: They always whisper to each other intimately.
It's not good to be too chummy at the office.
note: Often used to warn against excessive closeness in formal settings
